summary: Recent updates to the Canvas area of Firefox have focused on improving WebGL, the technology that enables rendering 3D graphics in browsers. One significant change is the addition of a support framework for Metal ANGLE (a translation layer for OpenGL) on macOS, which enhances performance for users relying on Apple's graphics API. Additionally, certain deprecated features, such as the support for `WEBGL_compressed_texture_pvrtc` across all platforms, have been disabled to streamline and modernize the codebase. Furthermore, improvements in memory management and cleaning up obsolete configurations will lead to a more robust and efficient graphical rendering experience. These updates aim to enhance overall performance and reliability, ultimately benefiting users who depend on rich visual content in their web applications. **Overall, this means a smoother graphics experience and better support for modern hardware.**
